input-field.name: clientId
input-field.label: Client ID
Klient-ID
input-field.helpText: Found in your Briqpay merchant portal under API credentials.

input-field.name: testMode
input-field.label: Test mode
Testläge
input-field.helpText: When enabled, requests are sent to the Briqpay playground API instead of production. The Client ID/Secret above must match the selected environment.

input-field.name: termsUrl
input-field.label: Terms & conditions URL
Länk till köpvillkor
input-field.helpText: Shown to the customer inside the Briqpay checkout. Falls back to the storefront's homepage if left empty.

input-field.name: verboseLogging
input-field.label: Verbose logging
Utökad loggning
input-field.helpText: Also writes informational events (webhook received, duplicate delivery ignored, reconciliation summaries) to the Shopware log. Warnings and errors are always logged. Only enable while troubleshooting, as these entries carry order and session identifiers.

input-field.name: webhookBaseUrl
input-field.label: Webhook base URL override
input-field.helpText: Only needed when your storefront isn't publicly reachable (e.g. local development). Overrides the domain Briqpay is told to send order/capture/refund status webhooks to — everything else (checkout, redirects) still uses your normal domain. Leave empty in production.

input-field.name: webhookBaseUrlSource
input-field.label: Webhook base URL discovery endpoint
input-field.helpText: Alternative to the field above: a URL that is polled for JSON like {"url": "https://example.com"} or {"hostname": "example.com"}. This matches the metrics endpoint a local tunnel exposes, so a development tunnel whose hostname changes on every restart is picked up without editing settings. The result is cached briefly. Ignored if the override above is set, and normally left empty in production.
